contract.known_boundary: Audio capture/playback and device-routing boundary with explicit format negotiation.

research_findings.capture_playback: Both candidates provide evidence for capture and playback on the six standard Flutter targets.
research_findings.device_routing: flutter-webrtc has explicit device enumeration and input/output selection evidence; audio_io has realtime platform backends but route-selection semantics still require validation.
research_findings.format_negotiation: audio_io provides explicit PCM/sample-rate evidence. The Library contract remains draft, so exact interface conformance is not asserted.
research_findings.raspberry_pi: Neither Flutter candidate is counted for Raspberry Pi. Upstream mackron/miniaudio explicitly lists Raspberry Pi and is the first target-specific family to research next, but that does not automatically transfer Pi support to WAMF/audio_io.
research_findings.security: Both pinned source trees are statically CLEAR and supply-chain CLEAR; both remain vulnerability REVIEW because exact Pub runtime dependency versions are unresolved and OSV was not queried.

decision.next_action: Research and pin two Raspberry Pi-specific audio I/O families, starting with mackron/miniaudio; then resolve immutable runtime dependency versions and perform target-specific runtime validation before any Library intake.
